title: Drummer Walter Brundy and his father's modern equipment
summary: Brundy was a pupil later a sax player killed in a car accident; the father always had the newest gear.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
